title: The Sweethearts (Top and Ball)
summary: The brightly painted spinning top offered his faithful heart to the elegant morocco leather ball, only to be mocked and rejected with haughty pride. The ball claimed royal descent...
full_text:
The brightly painted spinning top offered his faithful heart to the elegant morocco leather ball, only to be mocked and rejected with haughty pride. The ball claimed royal descent from Spanish slippers and bragged of her upcoming betrothal to a high-soaring swallow.

Years rolled by; the ball leaped too high and vanished over the rooftop into the forgotten gutters, while the humble top was gilded with real leaf-gold, becoming the pride of the parlor.

When at last they met by accident in the rubbish bin, the once-proud ball had rotted into a sodden lump of blackened cork, while the golden top spun away in honor, leaving vanity to contemplate its foolish disdain.
moral: Spurning sincere affection out of pretentious vanity leads to the rubbish bin of regret.
